payload.summary: PostToolUse hook (Write|Edit|NotebookEdit) that classifies written files against a JSON SSOT of line caps, measures breaches via wc -l, and drops a context_bloat_breach signal to claude-manager-helper. Non-blocking || true. Greenfield PostToolUse — no existing hook to modify.

files_to_create_or_edit.instruction: Add PostToolUse block — see brief §3.1 for exact JSON. Insert alongside existing PreToolUse and Stop keys.

New bash script — see brief §3.2 for full pseudocode. Make executable (chmod +x). Reads SSOT from docs/data/file-size-caps.json, classifies via jq, measures with wc -l, emits JSON signal on breach. Always exits 0.
New SSOT file — see brief §2 for exact JSON structure. 5 governed classes: agent-notebook (200L), sprint-task-index (80L), flow-file (120L), skill-file (120L), agent-definition (120L).

Add Pass 5b after existing Pass 5 (Size Caps). Pass 5b: consume context-bloat-*.json signals from docs/signals/; prune agent-notebook + sprint-task-index classes directly; escalate flow-file/skill-file/agent-definition class to architect subagent. See brief §4 for full protocol.
Add 'context_bloat_breach signal consumption' to capabilities list. Add docs/data/file-size-caps.json to lazy_load with trigger: pass_5b_bloat.

payload.sequencing: F3 before F2 (script reads SSOT). F2 before F1 (hook references script). F4+F5 in same commit as F1+F2+F3.
payload.commit_target: feat(hooks): context-bloat backstop hook + janitor Pass 5b
payload.self_test: See brief §6 for 4-step verification recipe. Critical: Test 3 proves non-blocking, Test 4 proves graceful SSOT-missing exit.
payload.dependency_note: Verify CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_PATH is the correct env var injected by Claude Code harness for PostToolUse hooks before implementing §3.2. Adjust env var name in script if SDK docs show a different name.
payload.size_justification_exception: Flow/skill/agent files with a <!-- size-justification: NL --> comment must NOT be flagged as violations by janitor Pass 5b — check for that comment before escalating.
